# Chip

Selectable pill for filter bars, tag pickers, and toggles, the interactive counterpart to Badge.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Chip` · Core

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Chip>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Chip>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Chip">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Selectable pill for filters and tags. Use Badge for read-only labels.

## Props (ChipProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` | `boolean` | Selected / active state (solid navy). @default false |
| `onToggle` | `(next: boolean, e: React.MouseEvent) => void` | Called with the next selected value when clicked. |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode` | Leading icon. |
| `removable` | `boolean` | Show a trailing × remove button (its own focusable control). @default false |
| `onRemove` | `(e: React.MouseEvent) => void` |  |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | aria-label of the remove button. @default "Remove {label}" |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Dim and block interaction. @default false |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md'` | @default "md" |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
